data.one_liner: A very compact representation of a placeholder for an image.
data.what_it_does: Provides encoding and decoding capabilities for BlurHash strings. Allows generating a compact placeholder hash from raw image bytes and decoding a hash back into image bytes.
use_when: You need compact string placeholders for images while they load
You want to encode images to BlurHash on supported platforms
avoid_when: You do not need image placeholders
You need high-level cached image widgets instead of low-level decoding
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic README examples
Platform-specific exceptions can be thrown during decoding
data.setup_notes: Add blurhash as a dependency in pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides complete image loading and caching with built-in placeholder support.

alternatives.name: octo_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers advanced image placeholder and error widget builders.
